@Dev_Fadnavis Stay Calm and Informed About HMPV
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus, often mild in most cases, similar to the common cold. With proper care and precautions, you can safeguard yourself and your family.
Precautions to Take:
• Maintain Hygiene: Wash hands
